in_marathi.name: Gunasekar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Knowledge, Power, Skill
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gunasekar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Guna means 'knowledge' or 'power' and Sekar means 'skill' or 'power'. The name Gunasekar thus signifies a person who possesses great knowledge and skill. In Hindu mythology, Gunasekar is the name of various gods and goddesses associated with wisdom, knowledge, and power.
